sentences.text: No; the original agreement’s clause 9.3 states a pre-payment charge of 2% of the principal outstanding, while the copy’s clause 9.3 states 3% of the principal outstanding.
The charge tables in each document match their own clause 9.3 wording: the original shows 2% of principal outstanding, and the copy shows 3% of principal outstanding, on pre-payment or foreclosure.
